ownership.quote: Oracle is among the 50 largest companies in the world by market cap, and ranked 52nd on the Forbes Global 2000 as of 2026.

stage.quote: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure is a product/division of Oracle Corporation, not a separately funded entity.
stage.note: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) is a business line of publicly traded Oracle Corporation (NYSE: ORCL), not an independently financed company, so no startup-style funding rounds exist.

last_round.quote: On March 12, 1986, the company had its initial public offering.

revenue.basis: Oracle Corporation consolidated total revenue per its FY2026 Form 10-K; OCI-specific revenue is not broken out separately from other cloud/license lines.

note: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) is the cloud infrastructure division of Oracle Corporation, a public company (NYSE: ORCL) founded 1977, IPO 1986. It has no independent funding history; all figures above are for the whole of Oracle Corporation since OCI's standalone financials are not separately disclosed. Oracle reported total FY2026 revenue of $67.36B and ~141,000 employees (down from ~162,000 a year earlier amid layoffs, including ~12,000 cut in India in April 2026).
